identity.teacher_guidance_note: Student pilot bakes CFG2; teacher public API is CFG1. This is not a same-guidance quality comparison.
identity.cold_scope: Fresh process and model; existing HuggingFace/disk cache, not a network cold download
identity.reference_decoding: SoundFile float32 mono at exact model sample rate; no resampling
identity.voice_cache_scope: Application-held state encoded on first request, reused with public API copy_state=True
identity.rss_scope: Process lifetime ru_maxrss on Linux, including model loading and previous requests
identity.latency_scope: Chunk availability during consumption, not sound-device playback latency
